profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with 10+ years of experience developing safety-critical and real-time embedded systems in aerospace, networking, and consumer electronics. Skilled in RTOS (Deos, VxWorks, FreeRTOS, SafeRTOS), bare-metal development, firmware design, bootloaders, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL). Experienced Scrum Master with proven success leading cross-functional teams, implementing CI/CD pipelines, static analysis tools, and safety certification processes (DO-178C). Adept at driver development, requirements definition, and vendor selection for complex embedded platforms.
I also have experience in robotics, developing dual-core motor-control firmware for a humanoid robotics platform on Zephyr RTOS. This includes EtherCAT and CAN-FD/CANopen communication, hard real-time control loops, lock-free inter-core communication, and layered safety interlocks. I have also worked on FPGA/adaptive SoC integration on Zynq UltraScale+, including datapath architecture review, Vivado build automation, and Yocto-based bitstream deployment.

Apart from development, I have supported and fixed system functionality. During my career, I have also maintained and supported servers, operating systems and network connectivity. Some of my previous responsibilities include analyzing, documenting and resolving problems with a keen focus on client satisfaction. I can work well independently and in team environments.

My key competencies include:

- Low level programming
- Firmware development in bare-metal and using RTOS (Zephyr, Deos, VxWorks, FreeRTOS)
- Device driver development
- Robotics motor control and industrial fieldbus (EtherCAT, CAN-FD/CANopen)
- FPGA/SoC integration (Zynq UltraScale+, Vivado, Yocto)
- Debugging and bug fixing
- Embedded software engineering
- System analysis

Please contact me at yogesh.kpat@gmail.com


Technical Skills 

Languages: 
C, C++, Embedded C, Python, Objective-C, Shell Scripting

RTOS & OS: 
Zephyr, Deos, VxWorks, FreeRTOS, SafeRTOS, ThreadX, QNX, Linux

Microcontrollers & Processors: 
NXP i.MX RT1189 (Cortex-M33/M7), TI C2000, NXP LPC/ARM Cortex, Xilinx Zynq, PowerPC, DSP (TMS320)

Protocols: 
EtherCAT, CAN/CAN-FD, CANopen, RS-485, I²C, SPI, UART, TCP/IP, ARINC 429/661, Zigbee

Tools: 
Matlab, Keil, WindRiver, Xcode, Visual Studio, Eclipse, Jenkins, Git, Vivado, Yocto

Processes: 
DO-178C, Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, Static Analysis, HAL, Networking (IPv4/IPv6, NAT, DPI)

positions.title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: EtherCAT · CANopen · Embedded Linux · Zephyr · CAN-FD · Xilinx Vivado · Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led projects by developing firmware and drivers for Wifi modules, Ethernet modules and other modules in a Linux operating system for a Intel, ARM and Mips based micro controller.
- Implemented firmware on user mode and kernel mode.
- Worked on RDKB and Yocto based design architecture, Inter-Process communication.
- Developing networking software such as Iptables, Deep Packet Inspection, NAT, IPv4, IPv6, TCP/IP
- Enhancing, Integrating and patching the kernel modules.
- Designing and writing Hardware Abstraction layer (HAL)
- Debugging, analyzing, resolving issues and maintaining software.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Key responsibilities included firmware development for a printer SoC based on Cortex A8 architecture.
-	Led projects by developing Firmware, Graphic User Interface (GUI), and display driver for Cortex A8 based processor with ThreadX Real-time operating system. 
-	Utilized Dstream JTAG, debugging and tracing application functions.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-	Viewed test results and located faults by updating and modifying python scripts to display EVT Automation outcomes from log files to web page. 
-	Maintained servers, ensuring system functioned with proper OS versions and configuration files with respect to Linux device driver version.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Responsible for developing iPad application, using REST web services to retrieve data from storage arrays and display them in the native UI app, providing flexibility to engineers and 24/7 support.
-	Responsible for providing embedded and hosted printing solutions, maintaining printer software, repairing memory bugs, and enhancing PDF parsing and processing.

positions.title: Embedded Electronic Engineer
positions.description:
-	Led development of Bare-metal firmware, using Keil MDK for ARM-7 based system for detecting gamma and x-ray dose level rate.
-	Implemented driver development for I2C and SPI based sensors, monitoring battery power level and memory usage.
-	Debugged firmware by using JTAG and Oscilloscopes.
-	Worked with system built on LPC2378 (ARM-7) microcontroller, using Zigbee to create WSN.

certifications.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Embedded Systems
certifications.title: Post Graduate Diploma in Embedded Systems

projects.title: Cyclometer - Modeling in Real Time System
projects.description: The project work included development of Real Time system using QNX and purple box. It took an engineering approach to the design of these systems by analyzing a model of the system before beginning implementation. UML was the primary modeling methodology

projects.title: High Performance Architecture Lab
projects.description: The lab work for this course includes parallel programming using NVIDIA graphics card. The final project was to implement Integration algorithms in parallel.
